name: Tunisia

findings.summary: Ooredoo Group announced a partnership with Huawei to upgrade its core networks toward 5G core / 5.5G readiness across several markets including Tunisia, where Ooredoo is the market leader.
findings.analyst_inference: Tier 2 because the sources call it a partnership without stating a binding contract or value; core network only, RAN vendor not established. Both sources relay the same Ooredoo/QNA announcement, so not treated as independent corroboration. Ooredoo is Qatari-controlled but equipment vendor sets the pole.

findings.summary: At a 2022 strategy summit marking 20 years of partnership, Tunisie Telecom and Huawei signed an MoU and agreed to set up an innovation lab to support 5G development.
findings.analyst_inference: Date from Tuniscope URL/snippet (not opened); Zawya page undated. A 20-year partnership suggests Huawei is a long-standing Tunisie Telecom supplier, but the 5G RAN vendor for the February 2025 launch was not named in sources opened.

findings.summary: At its first AI Summit, Ooredoo Tunisia announced a collaboration with NVIDIA to acquire high-performance GPUs for a sovereign AI-as-a-Service platform aimed at government bodies, startups and business clients.
findings.analyst_inference: Tier 1: an announced collaboration and intent to buy GPUs; no quantity, value, contract or deployment found. 'Sovereign' branding notwithstanding, accelerator vendor sets the pole. Neither source is S1/S2.

findings.summary: NVIDIA announced an AI innovation centre at Novation City in Sousse offering Tunisian developers training, technology access and networks to encourage AI adoption.
findings.analyst_inference: Coded silicon as an NVIDIA ecosystem/developer programme; no hardware deployment or scale stated, so tier 2 (pilot-type programme). Ecosystem signal rather than installed compute.

facilities.null_reason: one search surfaced only a planned 20MW Solecrypt solar data centre in Bizerte (status unclear, possibly not proceeding) and commentary; no large DC/AI campus with confirmed controller and stage found

models.null_reason: one search found national AI strategy coverage but no government partnership with a frontier model provider or sovereign model

applications.null_reason: surveillance search found municipal CCTV expansion (Grand Tunis 2018-19, Monastir smart-city video surveillance under review June 2026) with no vendor named

research_gaps: Which vendors (Huawei, Ericsson, Nokia, ZTE) built the 5G RAN for Tunisie Telecom, Ooredoo Tunisie and Orange Tunisie at the February 2025 launch?
Is the Ooredoo-Huawei 5G core upgrade a binding contract and has it been deployed in Tunisia?
Has Ooredoo Tunisia actually purchased/deployed NVIDIA GPUs for its sovereign AI-as-a-Service platform; where are they hosted?
Vendor for Grand Tunis and Monastir municipal video surveillance systems (Huawei/Hikvision/Dahua?).
Any Tunisian government LLM/e-government AI deployment and its model provider.
Status of Solecrypt Bizerte data centre and any other large data-centre projects.
